# skills

Reads a SKILL.md against a list of known smells, such as a description that never says when to use the skill, instructions that restate what the model already does, and a body too long to load. Reports each smell with its repair, and writes a new skill to the same bar.

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`skill-quality`](skills/skill-quality/README.md) | Reviews or authors SKILL.md and skill reference files for actionable skill smells and focused repairs. Use when writing, changing, or reviewing a skill. |

## Hooks

Ships hooks under `hooks/` for `claude`, `codex`, `copilot`. Plugin installation wires them.

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
/plugin install skills@Uraxii
```

Codex CLI:

```
codex plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai --ref main
codex plugin add skills@uraxii
```

Copilot CLI:

```
copilot plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
copilot plugin install skills@Uraxii
```

For other harnesses, see the [repository README](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai#install).
